scan_step_device_failed: A device security problem was found (developer mode, root, VPN or wrong phone time). The fingerprint was saved and sent for review.
scan_step_location_failed: A location problem was found (fake GPS, or the GPS and network locations do not match). The fingerprint was saved and sent for review.
scan_step_liveness_failed: The live face challenge was not completed. The fingerprint was saved and sent for review.
scan_step_identity_failed: The face could not be matched with the employee photo. The fingerprint was saved and sent for review.
fingerprint_rejected_reasons: The fingerprint was refused for the following reasons:
face_frame_instruction: Place your face inside the frame
face_frame_reason: We take a photo of your face to confirm that you are the one recording this fingerprint.
face_frame_reason_liveness: Do the movement shown above while your face stays inside the frame. It proves a real person is in front of the camera, not a photo.
face_frame_tip: Use good light, remove sunglasses or a mask, and make sure only you are in the picture.
face_status_no_face: No face detected: bring your face inside the frame
qr_scan_instruction: Point the camera at the branch QR code
qr_scan_reason: The QR code shows that you are at the branch when you record your fingerprint.
qr_scan_tip: Keep the code inside the frame and hold the phone still. Use the flash in low light.
qr_scan_no_camera: No camera was found. Connect a camera to this device, or record the fingerprint from the mobile app.
qr_scan_camera_denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
qr_scan_camera_error: The camera could not be opened. Close other apps that use the camera, then try again.
bluetooth_permission_required: Allow the Nearby devices and Location permissions to scan for the branch Bluetooth device.
bluetooth_location_service_off: Location is off. Some phones find no Bluetooth devices until location is turned on.
bluetooth_scan_hint: Nearby Bluetooth devices and branch beacons appear here. Stand near the branch device and make sure it is on.
bluetooth_no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices were found nearby.
